ccv3_rule: Fabric capacity error: stop all load on the first one; never retry through it.
resolution: REAL CONFLICT. Upstream says retry 429/503/504 with backoff. The fabric hub's first never-line overrides it: on any 429 or 430, stop all load and report. Only a single 503 or 504 on a status poll may retry once (fabric-playbook L-02, L-07).

ccv3_rule: Fabric capacity error: stop all load on the first one; never retry through it.
resolution: REAL CONFLICT in job-diagnostics and session-health: they say retry after a capacity check. The hub line wins: when the check finds throttling or a capacity error, stop and report. performance-patterns only lists 429 as a throttling symptom, which agrees.

ccv3_rule: Fabric capacity error: stop all load on the first one; never retry through it.
resolution: Retry-After on a 202 long-running operation is the poll interval, not a retry after an error. Allowed. The hub adds: cap every poll loop, because fabric_lro loops forever on a status it does not know (a 429 body has no status).
